decisions.reason: Simplifying the model interface does not change the confirmed debt/equity ratio, financing rate, tranche structure, mezzanine treatment, or refinement trigger; the shared word "simplified" is incidental.
The interface simplification decision does not change capex values, assumption sources, included costs, or the requirement to present shared program costs as separate line items.
Simplifying how the model is organized does not change the eight-site configuration, selected site-list source, or policy for modeling unavailable site-level data.
The source decision concerns interface comprehensibility and does not alter the operating-cost range, source, or exclusion of the incomplete appendix amount.
Model simplification does not remove or modify the required Canadian CCA treatment, asset classes, tax shield, or equity-return effects.
A simpler interface remains compatible with, and does not modify, the existing requirements to annotate assumptions and preserve their source basis.
The decision to simplify presentation does not change the requirement that formulas, worksheet links, and calculated outputs remain correct and credible.
The source does not alter the user-funded and PPP scenarios or the required finding that user fees alone cannot establish viability and bankability.
Interface simplification does not change the requirement to verify source data or the designated roles of the project brief, attachments, and demand analysis.
The request for a simpler model does not necessarily replace or modify the integrated three-statement structure or its financial-engine basis.
Simplifying the model interface has no effect on the required CAD currency or 2026 price base year.
The source decision does not change the required revenue streams, pricing assumption basis, or documentation of revenue assumptions.
